n14.why: F6a is a legend-less schematic of seeding, SEI self-healing and dual-layer deposition; MnO dissolution, the Mn0/Li2O mixed-conducting SEI and Li+ flux homogenisation are stated only in the linked text.

o1.why: F1a-f are Li deposits on Cu with the oxide separator named 'PP/xO'; they show dendrite-free sheets over sphere layers, clearest in b and d; the reader lacked the caption and took them for polymer composites.

o5.why: F2e O 1s peak sits at ~529.8 eV for MnO and ~531.3 eV for 'Reduced MnO', which the caption defines as after Li contact; the reader read the same shift but not the condition.
